Priority = signal 30% + entry 25% + edge 25% + runway 10% + setup quality 10%. It ranks how ready a name is to be acted on, for ordering this board — it is not a win probability or return forecast. McClellan Oscillator麦克莱伦振荡指标 ?Ratio-adjusted McClellan Oscillator: the 19-day minus 39-day EMA of net advances (normalised so a changing universe size doesn't distort it). Above zero & rising = breadth momentum building; below zero & falling = internals rolling over. The Summation Index is its running total — its slope and sign carry the meaning, not the absolute (cumulative) level.比率调整后的麦克莱伦振荡指标：净上涨家数的19日与39日指数均线之差（已归一化，避免样本规模变化造成失真）。高于零且上行 = 广度动量在累积；低于零且下行 = 内部结构在回落。累积指标是其累计和 — 关键在斜率与正负号，而非绝对（累计）水平。

Breadth Thrust (Zweig)广度脉冲（兹威格） ?The 10-day EMA of the advancers' share, advances / (advances + declines). Zweig's classic launch signal fires when it surges from below 0.40 (washed out) through 0.615 (thrust) inside 10 days — a rare, powerful 'everything's going up at once' kick-off. HONESTY: on our survivorship-biased S&P-500 proxy the strict crossing fires far more often than the canonical ~once-a-decade NYSE signal (rebuilt-from-survivors rebounds look broader than they were live), so read this as a momentum gauge, not the rare historic trigger.上涨家数占比（上涨 /(上涨+下跌)）的10日指数均线。兹威格的经典启动信号：在10日内自0.40以下（超卖）急升突破0.615（脉冲）时触发 —— 罕见而强劲的「同涨」启动。诚实说明：在带有幸存者偏差的标普500代理上，严格的穿越远比经典的纽交所「十年一遇」信号更频繁（以幸存者重建的反弹看起来比当时更广），故此处作为动量计读取，而非罕见的历史触发。

High-Low Index新高—新低指数 ?The 10-day average of the record-high percent: 52-week new highs as a share of (new highs + new lows). Above 50 = new highs are outpacing new lows (an expanding, healthy new-high ledger); below 50 = the new-low side is winning (deterioration). Today's raw net new highs (highs minus lows) and their 10-day average are shown below.记录新高占比的10日均值：52周新高占（新高+新低）的比例。高于50 = 新高多于新低（新高账本在扩张、健康）；低于50 = 新低占上风（恶化）。下方显示今日净新高（新高减新低）及其10日均值。

A/D line vs price腾落线对价格 ?Does the cumulative advance/decline line confirm the index's recent extremes? If price prints a fresh 3-month high the A/D line will NOT confirm, the advance is narrowing underneath (bearish divergence); a fresh price low the A/D line refuses to confirm is a bullish divergence. Otherwise the internals are confirming the move, or nothing is at an extreme (in range). The sparkline traces the A/D line; the correlation is price-vs-A/D over the last 60 sessions.累积腾落线是否确认指数近期的极值？若价格创3个月新高而腾落线未确认，则上涨在底层收窄（看跌背离）；若价格创新低而腾落线拒绝确认，则为看涨背离。否则即为内部结构确认走势，或均未触及极值（区间内）。曲线描绘腾落线；相关系数为近60个交易日价格与腾落线的相关性。
confirming the highs确认新高
the advance/decline line is making new highs alongside price — the move is broadly supported腾落线与价格同步创新高 — 走势获得广泛支撑. (60d corr 0.4)
Participation in context参与度的历史背景 ?Today's % of S&P 500 stocks above their 50-day line, set against its own deep history: the percentile tells you where this reading ranks vs every day since the universe matured, and the 20-day change is the momentum of participation (is it broadening or thinning?). The advance/decline line direction over 20 days rounds it out.今日标普500中高于50日均线的股票占比，对照其自身的深度历史：分位数显示该读数相对样本成熟以来每一天的排名，20日变化为参与度的动量（在扩散还是变薄？）。再辅以腾落线20日方向。

Sector buy/sell setups — short-term timing板块买卖配置 — 短线择时 ? The house sector-timing read, checked against the 200-day trend and sorted most-actionable first. Measured over 1998-2026 — the base-rate column is what each state actually went on to do over the next 63 days, against SPY:
stateread it asfwd 63d vs SPY*
BUYfresh up-turn on daily + 3-day, above trend+0.9% (56% up)
SETUPapproaching an up-cross — get ready+0.3..0.7%
EXTENDEDoverbought, late — hold/trim, don't chase~flat
TOPPINGoverbought + rolling over — distribution−0.1%
SELLoverbought + confirmed 3-day down-cross−1.2% (40% up)
BELOW TRENDunder the 200-day — knife; wait for a reclaim−0.1%
OVERSOLD BOUNCErange-bound defensive (XLU/XLP/XLV/XLRE), oversold dip below trend, Fed-put on — tactical bounce, lags SPY+4.0% abs / +0.3% vs SPY
*measured per state across the 11 sector ETFs. The OVERSOLD BOUNCE row's headline is its ABSOLUTE return (the dip bounces); its vs-SPY is shown beside it because a low-beta defensive tends to lag a rising index — a tactical mean-reversion trade, never a confirmed buy. Honest ceiling: hit-rates ~50-56% — the edge is in magnitude and in AVOIDANCE (it stops you chasing the "confirmed leadership" that institutions distribute into), not a high win-rate. A risk/timing map, not a return forecast. 本系统的板块择时读数，以 200 日趋势把关，按可操作性排序。用 1998–2026 的数据测算过—— 基础概率一列，是各个状态在随后 63 天里对 SPY 的实际表现：
状态解读未来63日对SPY*
买入日线+3日线同时转上，且在趋势之上+0.9%（56%上涨）
预备接近上穿——准备+0.3..0.7%
过热超买、已晚——持有/减仓，勿追≈持平
见顶超买+回落——派发−0.1%
卖出超买+3日线确认下穿−1.2%（40%上涨）
趋势下方200日线下方——接飞刀；等待收复−0.1%
超卖反弹区间震荡的防御板块（XLU/XLP/XLV/XLRE），趋势下方超卖回调、美联储托底在位——战术反弹，跑输SPY+4.0% 绝对 / +0.3% 对SPY
*按状态、跨 11 个板块 ETF 实测。「超卖反弹」一行的主数字是其绝对回报（回调会反弹）；旁边的对SPY数字 说明低贝塔防御板块在上涨指数中通常跑输——属战术性均值回归交易，绝非确认买入。诚实上限：胜率约 50–56%——优势在于幅度与「回避」（避免追逐机构 派发的「已确认领先」），而非高胜率。这是风险/择时地图，不是收益预测。

sector板块 verdict判断 ?BUY/SETUP = an entry above the 200-day; EXTENDED/TOPPING/SELL = late or distributing; BELOW TREND = a knife. Dots = how many of the timeframes we check agree.买入/预备＝200 日线上方的入场；过热/见顶/卖出＝偏晚或正在派发；趋势下方＝接飞刀。圆点＝我们查看的几个周期里有多少个一致。 3-day signal3 日信号 ?What actually happened on the 3-day chart: a fresh signal, one turning up and about to fire (with how many sessions away), or one rolling over.3 日图上实际发生了什么：新信号触发、正在拐头、马上要触发（附还差几个交易日），或者已经开始回落。 trend趋势 ?Price vs its 200-day (long-term) and 50-day (medium-term) average — the gate that separates a buyable pullback from a falling knife.价格相对 200 日（长期）与 50 日（中期）均线——把可买回调与接飞刀分开的闸门。 Momentum (3D)动量（3 日） ?Two momentum readings on the 3-day chart. High means the move is stretched and late; turning up from the low end is the bottoming tell, falling out of the high end is the topping tell.3 日图上的两个动量读数。数值高说明这波已经拉得很开、偏晚；从低位转上来是见底的迹象，从高位掉下来是见顶的迹象。 3mo vs mkt3 月对比市场 ?Relative strength vs the S&P 500 over the past ~60 trading days.过去约 60 个交易日相对标普 500 的强弱。 seasonality季节性 ?This sector's average return in the current calendar month. Hover for the full 12-month picture.
